title: 第22章 碰瓷第23章 当好学生我偏不
content_zh:
只见古玩街上的人流比平常多了许多，走近一看竟是有一处地方被人群包围得水泄不通，而且看样子周围还有很多人赶着去看热闹。
白月心下一阵疑惑，逮着一个正要往那人群中去的妇人。
故作萌态地甜甜问道：“阿姨，那里发生什么事了吗？怎么这么多人？”
瞧见拦住自己的是一个可爱水灵的女娃娃，妇人看着双眼一亮。
边拉着她往人群中去，边同她说道：“小朋友，想去看热闹吗？走，阿姨带你去。”
“听说呀，是有一个摊贩和一个老大爷起了冲突，说是那老大爷砸碎了他的古董花瓶，按他的话说，那花瓶可是元朝的青花瓷器，价值连城呢，这下就有好戏看了。”
待这位妇人拉着她挤进人群后，也的确如之前所说的那样，一个看着就一副奸商模样的摊贩正对着一位老大爷不断地谩骂索赔，还不时的口吐芬芳，一旁的地上还有着一地的瓷器碎片，明眼人一看这就是典型的碰瓷。
白月都不需要用特殊能力看那些地上的碎片，就能看出那明显是个粗制滥造的赝品。
而反观面前这位老大爷，虽然衣着看似普通，但是那眼神中的威严和气势分明就是长期身居高位的人才能拥有的。
只不过他一直默不作声并不是怕了这无赖摊贩，而是根本没有把他当一回事。
眼看这摊贩一直不依不饶和这渐渐增加的围观人群，纵是老爷子也觉得有些不耐。
他此次本就是故意不让人跟随，好来个‘微服私访’，却不想遇上这么一个难缠的无赖！
本想着趁乱出手，结果人群中却冲出了一个长相俏皮可爱的小女孩，抱着他的大腿直叫爷爷，令他丈二和尚摸不着头脑，这究竟唱的是哪一出。
冲出人群的人自然是白月，而她为什么要冲出来，并不是因为同情心泛滥想要在这事上插一脚，而是因为方才把她拉进人群的妇人极有可能是一个人贩子。
那妇人在看到白月这么水灵的一个女孩子时便起了心思，故意把孩子带到人群中看热闹，降低小女孩对陌生人的防范，在拉走这个女孩时还四处观察着周围有无孩子的家属。
确认无误后，这妇人便想直接把白月抱走。
很可惜，白月并不是一般的小女孩，并不会让她得逞，不过周围人多口杂，白月也不好直接对这妇人动手，便急中生智，朝着热闹中心的老爷子扑去。
“爷爷，月儿终于找到你了！你刚才走得这么快，都把月儿弄丢了。”
白月一副梨花带雨的表情抱着老爷子哭喊道。
接着转头便看到那无良摊贩还在朝他们谩骂着，便立刻板起了小脸道：“哪里来的蟋蟀，唧唧喳喳的在这叫个不停，还敢欺负我爷爷，看我不教训你！”

看那气鼓鼓的架势，好像真是别人在欺负她爷爷似的，不由得让旁人相信这小女孩真的是那老爷子的孙女。
“哪来的小屁孩，毛都还没长齐就想教训老子？老老实实叫你爷爷赔我这元青花的钱，我还能不追究，否则我就立刻报警叫你们爷孙俩到局子里吃牢饭！”
这无良摊贩见来的不过是一个女娃娃，更是嚣张的出言威胁。
“呵！好大的口气，你真知道元青花是什么吗？你倒是说说你这花瓶打哪来的？”
白月反问着眼前的无良摊贩。
“我凭什么要告诉你地点？这是我从山上捡来的！”
无良摊贩一脸的嚣张。
“既然是捡来的，那你怎么知道它就是真的元青花？”
“既然你那么断定它是真的，那必定价值不菲，那为什么这瓷器你并不好好放在盒中保管，反而还裸露在外？”
白月看着他的眼神质问道。
“我...我当时是为了拿去鉴定，一时心急所以没有拿盒子装好！”
content_en:
I saw that the number of people on the Antique Street was much larger than usual. When I got closer, I saw that there was a place surrounded by crowds, and it seemed that there were many people rushing around to watch the fun.
Bai Yue felt doubtful in her heart and caught a woman who was about to go into the crowd.
Pretending to be cute, she asked sweetly: "Auntie, what happened there? Why are there so many people?"
The woman's eyes lit up when she saw that the person blocking her was a cute and charming female doll.
While pulling her into the crowd, he said to her: "Kid, do you want to watch the fun? Come on, Auntie will take you there."
"I heard that a street vendor had a conflict with an old man. He said that the old man smashed his antique vase. According to him, the vase was a blue and white porcelain from the Yuan Dynasty and was priceless. Now there will be a good show."
After the woman pulled her into the crowd, it was indeed as mentioned before that a vendor who looked like a profiteer was constantly cursing and demanding compensation from an old man. He also breathed fragrance from time to time. There were fragments of porcelain on the ground beside him. A discerning eye could see that this was a typical case of porcelain.
Bai Yue didn't even need to use special abilities to look at the fragments on the ground to see that they were obviously crude fakes.
On the other hand, the old man in front of him, although his clothes seemed ordinary, the majesty and momentum in his eyes were clearly possessed by people who have been in high positions for a long time.
It's just that he kept silent not because he was afraid of this rogue vendor, but because he didn't take him seriously at all.
Seeing the vendor's reluctance and the growing crowd of onlookers, even the old man felt a little impatient.
He had deliberately not allowed anyone to follow him this time so that he could have a 'private visit', but he didn't want to meet such a difficult scoundrel!
He thought of taking advantage of the chaos to take action, but in the end, a cute and playful little girl rushed out from the crowd, hugged his thigh and called him grandpa, leaving the monk who was two feet tall and confused as to which song he was singing.
The person who rushed out of the crowd was naturally Bai Yue, and why she rushed out was not because she was overflowing with sympathy and wanted to have a hand in this matter, but because the woman who just pulled her into the crowd was most likely a human trafficker.
When the woman saw a girl as lively as Bai Yue, she became interested. She deliberately brought the child to the crowd to watch the fun, lowering the little girl's guard against strangers. When she took the girl away, she also looked around to see if there were any family members with children around.
After confirming that it was correct, the woman wanted to take Bai Yue away directly.
It's a pity that Bai Yue is not an ordinary little girl, and he will not let her succeed. However, there are many people around her who are talking nonsense, so Bai Yue can't just attack this woman directly, so she rushes towards the old man in the center of the excitement.
"Grandpa, Yue'er has finally found you! You were walking so fast just now, and you even lost Yue'er."
Bai Yue hugged the old man and cried with an expression of pear blossoms and rain.
Then he turned around and saw that the unscrupulous vendor was still cursing at them, and he immediately said with a straight face: "Where did the cricket come from? It's chirping here non-stop, and you dare to bully my grandpa. See if I don't teach you a lesson!"
Looking at her angry attitude, it seemed as if someone was really bullying her grandfather, and others couldn't help but make others believe that the little girl was really the granddaughter of the old man.
"Where did you come from, you little brat, you want to teach me a lesson before your hair is fully grown? Tell your grandpa to pay me Yuan Qinghua's money. How can I not pursue it? Otherwise, I will immediately call the police and ask you and your grandson to go to jail!"
What this unscrupulous vendor saw was just a female doll, and he threatened her arrogantly.
"Ha! What a loud tone. Do you really know what Yuan Qinghua is? Could you please tell me where you got this vase?"
Bai Yue asked the unscrupulous vendor in front of her.
"Why should I tell you the location? I picked this up from the mountain!"
The face of an unscrupulous vendorThe arrogance.
"Since it was picked up, how do you know it is the real Yuan Qinghua?"
"Since you are so sure that it is real, it must be worth a lot of money. Then why don't you keep this porcelain in a box for safekeeping, but instead leave it exposed?"
Bai Yue looked at him and asked.
"I... I wanted to take it for appraisal, but I was anxious so I didn't pack it in the box!"
